title: Dynamic Governed Recovery Orchestrator (server-managed source foundation)

phases.objective: Prove a source-only provider-neutral Recovery Orchestrator with immutable plans, pre-dispatch intent, fenced Staging-only execution, unknown-outcome reconciliation and admin-only read-only capability discovery; no mutation authority is activated in this PR.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Server-owned Recovery Orchestrator API invoked with an exact persisted plan and injected simulated adapters
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A verified Staging mock operation reaches recovered only after atomic claim, pre-dispatch durable intent, lease fencing and independent readback. Lost provider ACK remains UNKNOWN and must reconcile without re-execution.
steps: Discover a registered server-owned adapter and its typed operation; reject caller-selected credentials or URLs.
Create a read-only inspected content-addressed plan binding tenant, resource, exact source SHA and environment.
Re-inspect exact resource and reject descriptor/state drift, stale plan, or missing approval.
Atomically claim once, persist the intent before dispatch and confirm lease fence.
Invoke synthetic Staging executor and require independent postcondition readback and durable finalization.
Simulate lost ACK, blocked retry, irreversible recovered state and independently verified UNKNOWN reconciliation.
assertions: No Production mutation or live provider dispatch is possible.
No external side effect before durable intent, unique claim and fencing.
An ambiguous or lost finalization ACK never automatically repeats the provider operation.
Only a separate trusted verifier can promote to RECOVERED.
The test uses synthetic in-memory adapters and explicitly does not certify the actual database or provider.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Only a server-provided descriptor catalog is visible behind backend API key and admin principal, with no write endpoints or implicit executors.
steps: Mount the new router through the platform's central router registry.
Enforce Backend API key and Admin Principal using existing guards.
Read server-owned registered adapter metadata; absent registry returns empty inventory.
Verify no mutation endpoint or Production authority appears in output.
assertions: No user-provided credential, host, SQL, script, or private-key field is accepted.
The GET route never executes a provider method.
The route is registered in the central application.
The route has no POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE variant.
